description: Read one posting in full by the slug a search result carries: the whole description, the stated requirements, which applicant tracking system handles applications, and whether the posting still looks live — when it was last seen open, a reality class, and any observed signs that it is not being filled.

slug.description: the posting's identifier, as carried by a search result's slug

name: get_job

apply_requires.description: what the employer's application form requires

apply_via.description: the applicant tracking system handling applications

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes the role is open in

fake_freshness.description: true when the posted date is recent but freehire has seen the posting for 90 days or more; present whenever reality is

first_seen_at.description: RFC3339 UTC; when freehire first saw this posting — a posted_at far newer than this means the date was refreshed

ghost_criteria.description: the signs behind ghost_level: evergreen_posting, ats_absent (gone from the employer's own board), silent_applications, user_reports

ghost_level.description: possible or likely: observed signs that the posting is not being actively filled; absent when there is too little evidence

last_seen_at.description: RFC3339 UTC; when a re-crawl last confirmed the posting live on its source

official_job_url.description: the employer's own posting, when known

reality.description: fresh, stale or likely-evergreen: whether the posting looks like a live opening, judged from its age and repost history

source.description: the job board this posting was collected from

summary.description: a short preview, not the full description

title: Read one job posting
